raw_segments.text: I am, indeed, persuaded that the heart, as well as the understanding, is opened by cultivation,
and by, which may not appear so clear, strengthening the organs, I am not now talking of momentary
flashes of sensibility, but of affections.
And perhaps, in the education of both sexes, the most difficult task is so to adjust instruction
as not to narrow the understanding, whilst the heart is warmed by the generous juices
of spring, just raised by the electric fermentation of the season, nor to dry up the feelings
by employing the mind in investigations remote from life.
